```{r}
source("00_requirements.R")
# Load cleaned dataset
load("C:/Users/zirei/OneDrive/Documents/GitHub/Stat107_Final_Project/12_DataSaving.RData")
# Examine dataset
dim(clean_data)
glimpse(clean_data)
# Keep universities classified as four-year
four_year_data <- clean_data %>%
  filter(ICLEVEL == 1)
# Examine number of four-year universities
nrow(four_year_data)
# Check university levels
table(four_year_data$ICLEVEL)
# Selected STEM-related academic categories
stem_vars <- c(
  "PCIP11",  # Computer and information sciences
  "PCIP14",  # Engineering
  "PCIP15",  # Engineering technologies
  "PCIP26",  # Biological and biomedical sciences
  "PCIP27",  # Mathematics and statistics
  "PCIP40",  # Physical sciences
  "PCIP41"   # Science technologies
  )
# Verify all STEM variables exist
if (!all(stem_vars %in% names(four_year_data))) {
  stop("One or more STEM variables are missing.")
}
# Calculate the total STEM degree proportion
four_year_data <- four_year_data %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(stem_vars),
      ~ as.numeric(as.character(.x))
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    STEM_SHARE = if_else(
      if_all(all_of(stem_vars), ~ !is.na(.x)),
      rowSums(pick(all_of(stem_vars))),
      NA_real_))
# Examine STEM proportions
summary(four_year_data$STEM_SHARE)
# Classify universities based on STEM degree proportion
# 50% or more = predominantly STEM-focused
four_year_data <- four_year_data %>%
  mutate(
    STEM_FOCUSED = case_when(
      is.na(STEM_SHARE) ~ NA,
      STEM_SHARE >= 0.50 ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE))
# Count STEM-focused and non-STEM-focused universities
table(
  four_year_data$STEM_FOCUSED,
  useNA = "ifany")
# Keep the 50 US states
us_states <- c(
  "AL", "AK", "AZ", "AR", "CA", "CO", "CT", "DE",
  "FL", "GA", "HI", "ID", "IL", "IN", "IA", "KS",
  "KY", "LA", "ME", "MD", "MA", "MI", "MN", "MS",
  "MO", "MT", "NE", "NV", "NH", "NJ", "NM", "NY",
  "NC", "ND", "OH", "OK", "OR", "PA", "RI", "SC",
  "SD", "TN", "TX", "UT", "VT", "VA", "WA", "WV",
  "WI", "WY")
# Restrict data to the 50 states
four_year_data <- four_year_data %>%
  filter(STABBR %in% us_states)
# Aggregate university information by state
state_summary <- four_year_data %>%
  group_by(STABBR) %>%
  summarise(
    TOTAL_UNIVERSITIES = n(),

    UNIVERSITIES_WITH_STEM_DATA =
      sum(!is.na(STEM_FOCUSED)),

    STEM_UNIVERSITIES =
      sum(STEM_FOCUSED %in% TRUE),

    STEM_PROPORTION =
      if_else(
        UNIVERSITIES_WITH_STEM_DATA > 0,
        STEM_UNIVERSITIES /
          UNIVERSITIES_WITH_STEM_DATA,
        NA_real_
      ),

    UNIVERSITIES_WITH_GRAD_DATA =
      sum(!is.na(C150_4)),

    AVG_GRAD_RATE =
      if (all(is.na(C150_4))) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        mean(C150_4, na.rm = TRUE)
      },

    MEDIAN_GRAD_RATE =
      if (all(is.na(C150_4))) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        median(C150_4, na.rm = TRUE)
      },

    .groups = "drop")
# Display state-level results
print(state_summary)
# Classify states according to their STEM proportion
state_summary <- state_summary %>%
  mutate(
    STATE_GROUP = case_when(
      is.na(STEM_PROPORTION) ~ NA_character_,
      STEM_PROPORTION > 0.40 ~ "Above 40%",
      TRUE ~ "40% or Below"))
# Create dataset for comparisons
state_analysis <- state_summary %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(STATE_GROUP),
    !is.na(AVG_GRAD_RATE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    STATE_GROUP = factor(
      STATE_GROUP,
      levels = c("40% or Below", "Above 40%"))  )
# Count states in each group
table(state_analysis$STATE_GROUP)
# Compare average graduation rates
state_analysis %>%
  group_by(STATE_GROUP) %>%
  summarise(
    NUMBER_OF_STATES = n(),
    MEAN_GRAD_RATE = mean(AVG_GRAD_RATE),
    MEDIAN_GRAD_RATE = median(AVG_GRAD_RATE),
    SD_GRAD_RATE = sd(AVG_GRAD_RATE),
    .groups = "drop")
# Save processed datasets
save(
  four_year_data,
  state_summary,
  state_analysis,
  stem_vars,
  file = "C:/Users/zirei/OneDrive/Documents/GitHub/Stat107_Final_Project/22_DataSaving.RData")
# Export state summary as CSV
write_csv(
  state_summary,
  "C:/Users/zirei/OneDrive/Documents/GitHub/Stat107_Final_Project/22_StateSummary.csv")
# Confirm saved results
dim(four_year_data)
dim(state_summary)
dim(state_analysis)
```
